changes.what: The plain addresses corporatetambola.com and www.corporatetambola.com now send you to home.corporatetambola.com, so there is one address for this website.
Home now shows three games: Tambola, Bingo and Lucky Draw. The other three are not offered here for now. The page text, the share picture and the games bar say three games.
changes.where: index, games, privacy page, all footers, games bar, share picture

changes.what: Stay signed in on the same phone or laptop. If you are already signed in to your console, this website now shows Signed in and an Open console button, so you do not sign in a second time.
When a page opens, this website asks your console one plain question: are you signed in? Nothing about you is saved. If the console cannot be reached or says no, the page looks exactly as before.
The Data and privacy page now says, in a few plain lines, how staying signed in works and when you may need to sign in again.
The Sign in button keeps the same width when it turns into Open console, so nothing on the page moves. On a small laptop it says Console, to fit.
If your browser sends a privacy signal (Global Privacy Control or Do Not Track), it now counts as No. Nothing is asked and nothing is stored until you press Yes yourself.
Saying No now removes the offline copy of the pages for good, even a copy made by an older version of this website, and it does not come back.
The offline copy now starts only after you say Yes, never on its own.
The fair-play line about numbers now sits only with Tambola and Bingo, where it is true.
Plainer words on the Data and privacy page about cookies and your device.
Checked on a small phone, 360 px wide: every page fits, also while the cookie question is open.
Signing in now happens in one place: your console. This website only links you there, and never asks for a password.
A clear cookie choice. Nothing is stored on your device until you answer, and No, thanks is always fine.
A pricing page with the real credit packs, in rupees and in US dollars. No GST is added.
Clearer promises: fair play, everything about your players erased within 24 hours, and you give the prizes directly to the winners.
Two looks, Retro and Modern, each with light and dark colours.
Better search results and link previews when pages are shared.
This What's new page, and the version number at the bottom of every page.
Lucky Draw is shown as coming soon.
Kinder, truer privacy words. The offline copy of the pages is kept only after you say Yes.
